About the Role:

Binance is looking for a creative, data-driven marketer to own content, brand voice, social media, and organic search across the Philippines and wider SEA. You'll be the local voice for one of the world's most recognised crypto brands — shaping how we show up on TikTok, X, and Google in one of our fastest-moving regions, and turning that presence into measurable audience and organic growth. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role with direct regional exposure: your work ships in-market within days, not quarters.

What You'll Do:

• Build localized content across social, campaigns, blogs, and marketing collateral — written to land with a PH audience, not translated at it.

• Own our local social channels (Facebook, X, Instagram, TikTok and beyond) end to end: content calendars, campaigns, community engagement, and trend response.

• Grow organic search performance through keyword research, on-page optimization, and content that ranks — coordinating with regional SEO teams on strategy.

• Protect brand consistency, ensuring every asset carries the right message and visual identity across SEA markets.

• Partner with regional marketing on SEA market campaign execution, branding activities, and product launches.

• Measure and report on content, social, SEO, and campaign performance — turning the numbers into clear recommendations.

What We're Looking For:

• 2–4 years in content marketing, social media, branding, or SEO — agency or in-house.

• Bilingual English/Tagalog is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders.

• Hands-on experience running social platforms for a brand: calendar planning, publishing, and community engagement.

• Working knowledge of SEO tools and Google Analytics, and what content optimization actually means in practice.

• Comfort with data: you can read a performance report and decide what to change.

• Self-directed — able to move without a full team around you.

Nice to Haves:

• Interest in or exposure to crypto, blockchain, or Web3.

• Prior experience across multiple SEA markets

Why Binance

• Shape the future of finance

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. About us

Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 100+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution.

Bitget is driving crypto adoption through strategic partnerships with LALIGA and MotoGP™. Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

• Contract & Product Design: Define derivatives product specifications: contract size and multiplier, tick size, price limits, trading hours, expiry and rollover, final settlement method, and fee structure. Manage the product shelf and new contract launches.
• Order Flow & Trading Experience: Own order entry and execution flows across UI and API: order types (limit, market, stop, stop-limit, reduce-only, etc.), time-in-force, order amendments and cancellations, and fills and execution reporting.
• FIX & Connectivity: Define requirements for FIX and REST/WebSocket connectivity for order routing, execution reports, drop copies and market data. Work with engineering and counterparties on session management, certification/conformance testing, and failover.
• Pre-Trade Risk Controls: Design pre-trade checks such as buying power and margin checks, max order size, price bands/fat-finger protection, position limits, and self-trade prevention. Make sure they work consistently across all channels.
• Margin Framework: Turn margin methodologies (initial and maintenance margin, risk-based/portfolio margin models such as SPAN-style approaches, intraday margin) into product logic, user-facing displays and notifications. Define margin call workflows and deadlines.
• Liquidation Process: Own the end-to-end liquidation process with Risk: risk monitoring, margin call and warning notifications, auto/forced liquidation logic (order types, sequencing, partial vs full), handling of deficits and negative balances, and post-event customer communication and reconciliation.
• Mark Price, Settlement & Statements: Define mark/settlement price logic, daily variation margin and P&L settlement, final settlement at expiry, and daily/monthly statements, and work with Operations on reconciliation of positions, balances and fees.
• Market Events & Operations: Define product behavior and runbooks for trading halts, price limit events, connectivity outages, error trades and trade busts.
• Regulatory Alignment: Work with Compliance and Legal so that trading features, disclosures and records meet derivatives regulatory requirements.
• Metrics: Track trading volume, open interest, order rejection rates, latency, margin call/liquidation rates and trading-related support issues.

﻿What you'll need

• 5+ years of product management experience on futures/derivatives trading products, at an FCM, DCM, DCO, introducing broker, crypto derivatives exchange or brokerage.
• Solid working knowledge of the FIX protocol (order entry, execution reports, drop copy, market data) and trading APIs.
• Deep understanding of futures margining (initial/maintenance, variation margin, risk-based margin models) and liquidation processes, including real-world handling of volatile market events.
• Strong knowledge of order types, matching and execution, pre-trade risk controls, and contract specifications.
• Understanding of clearing and settlement processes and how positions, balances and P&L reconcile across trading, clearing and brokerage systems.
• Familiarity with crypto derivatives (perpetuals, dated futures, leverage) and how they differ from traditional futures (24/7 trading, funding mechanisms, liquidation models).
• Working knowledge of US derivatives market structure and CFTC/NFA requirements.
• Ability to write rigorous PRDs that specify trading logic, edge cases and failure modes precisely.
• Strong collaboration with Risk, Engineering, Operations and Compliance; calm, structured decision-making during live market incidents.

岗位职责：
• 合约与产品设计：定义衍生品合约规格，包括合约大小与乘数、最小变动价位（Tick Size）、价格限制、交易时间、到期与展期机制、最终结算方式及费率结构；管理产品货架及新合约上线流程。
• 订单流与交易体验：负责 UI 和 API 端的订单录入与执行流程，涵盖订单类型（限价、市价、止损、止盈限价、只减仓等）、有效时间（Time-in-Force）、订单修改与撤销、成交回报及执行报告。
• FIX 协议与连接性： 定义用于订单路由、执行报告、Drop Copy 和市场数据的 FIX 及 REST/WebSocket 连接需求；协同工程团队与交易对手方完成会话管理、认证/一致性测试及故障转移机制。
• 事前风控机制：设计事前风控检查逻辑，包括购买力与保证金校验、最大订单限制、价格波段/防胖手指保护、持仓限制及自成交预防确保所有交易渠道的风控逻辑一致。
• 保证金框架：将保证金方法论（初始/维持保证金、基于风险的投资组合保证金模型如 SPAN、日内保证金）转化为产品逻辑、前端展示及通知机制；定义追加保证金（Margin Call）的工作流与时限。
• 强平流程：协同风控团队拥有端到端的强平流程所有权，包括风险监控、追加保证金预警通知、自动/强制强平逻辑（订单类型、排队顺序、部分或全部强平）、穿仓/负余额处理，以及事后的客户沟通与对账。
• 标记价格、结算与账单：定义标记价格/结算价格逻辑、每日逐日盯市盈亏结算、到期最终结算，以及日/月对账单；协同运营团队完成持仓、余额及费用的对账。
• 市场事件与运营支持：定义交易暂停、触板、连接中断、错误交易及撤单（Trade Busts）等极端市场情况下的产品行为与应急操作手册（Runbooks）。
• 合规对齐：协同合规与法务团队，确保交易功能、信息披露及记录留存符合衍生品监管要求。
• 数据指标监控：追踪交易量、持仓量、订单拒绝率、延迟、强平/追加保证金比率及交易相关客诉指标。

任职要求：
• 经验背景：5年以上期货/衍生品交易产品管理经验，任职于 FCM（期货佣金商）、DCM、DCO、介绍经纪商、加密衍生品交易所或券商。
• 技术协议：扎实掌握 FIX 协议（订单录入、执行报告、Drop Copy、市场数据）及交易 API 的工作原理。
• 核心机制理解：深刻理解期货保证金体系（初始/维持保证金、逐日盯市、基于风险的保证金模型如 SPAN）及强平流程，具备处理极端波动行情的实战经验。
• 交易逻辑：精通订单类型、撮合与执行机制、事前风控及合约规格设计。
• 清算与对账：理解清算与结算流程，以及交易、清算和经纪系统间持仓、余额及盈亏的对账逻辑。
• 加密衍生品知识：熟悉加密衍生品（永续合约、交割合约、杠杆机制）及其与传统期货的区别（7x24小时交易、资金费率机制、强平模型）。
• 监管合规：具备美国衍生品市场结构及 CFTC/NFA 监管要求的工作知识。
• 文档能力：能够撰写严谨的产品需求文档（PRD），精确描述交易逻辑、边缘案例及故障模式。
• 协作与抗压：具备与风控、工程、运营及合规团队高效协作的能力；在市场突发事件中保持冷静、结构化的决策能力。

Why Bitget?
• Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
• We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
• We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
• We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
• We offer competitive salaries and benefits
• Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!

If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

• A quality-first mindset: experience implementing data contracts, lineage tracking, observability tooling, and pipeline SLO monitoring in a production environment

Turn audience findings into clear actions across targeting, exclusions, budget allocation, creative briefs and campaign structure.

Convert findings into clear test hypotheses and prioritised recommendations rather than descriptive commentary.

Brief the creative team on new concepts, iterations and platform-native variations, including objective, audience, insight, hook, message, format, required versions and success metric.

Track assets from briefing through launch and post-test analysis, documenting learning for future iterations and localisation.

Monitor post-click conversion performance using available analytics, segmented by platform, campaign, audience, creative, device, market and landing page where useful.

Identify likely friction, message mismatch, weak journey alignment, broken links, tracking gaps or page-performance issues that may suppress conversion.

Check destination URLs, deep links, app-store routes, UTMs and campaign-to-page alignment as part of launch and ongoing QA.

Brief CRO, web, product or app teams on evidence-based improvement and testing opportunities; this role supports analysis and briefing rather than owning the full CRO roadmap or development.

Use public platform ad-transparency and creative-discovery resources, alongside market observations, to identify material shifts and testable themes.

Turn observations into practical recommendations for messaging, creative formats, audience hypotheses, landing pages or structured tests.

Define a clear hypothesis, control and variant, primary success metric, guardrails and expected decision before launch.

Interpret results carefully, distinguishing directional evidence from conclusive findings and documenting limitations.

Record outcomes, decisions and next actions so learning can be reused across platforms and markets.

Run weekly analysis for assigned markets and identify key performance drivers, blockers, risks and opportunities independently.

Provide actionable creative, audience, placement, platform and landing-page insights with clear owners and next actions.

Use spreadsheets confidently for pivots, lookups, reconciliations and large platform exports.

Maintain clear documentation for tests, budget moves, structural changes and material optimisation decisions.

Turn around agreed ad hoc requests to deadline while protecting planned priorities.

Organise concurrent market and platform priorities effectively and deliver to agreed timelines.

Collaborate with creative, CRO/web, app, analytics, MarTech, compliance and agency partners while retaining clear ownership of paid social execution.

Proven day-to-day campaign delivery across Meta, with practical hands-on execution across TikTok and X.

Experience managing both web and app acquisition campaigns, including optimisation to conversion and app events.

About the Team

OKX Internal Audit is the organization's independent third line of defense, reporting to the Board and the Group Audit and Risk Committee on the design and effectiveness of governance, risk management, and internal controls across a global, multi-entity crypto exchange. The function executes a risk-based annual audit plan covering financial, operational, technology, security, and regulatory risk, and operates with full, unrestricted access to systems, records, and personnel.

Within Internal Audit, the Platform & Infrastructure team sits inside the Global Platform & Engineering (GP&E) team and owns assurance over the technology foundation that keeps the exchange running: network administration, cloud infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code, containerization and orchestration, middleware services, site reliability and disaster recovery, and the data pipelines feeding OKX's financial and operational systems. Reflecting a multi-cloud environment (AWS, Alibaba Cloud, GCP) supporting live trading, custody, and customer-facing operations on a global scale.

About the Role

As Senior Manager, Platform & Infrastructure Audit, you'll be a hands-on, deeply technical individual-contributor auditor who owns critical assurance projects spanning the cloud infrastructure and DevOps lifecycle, from platform build and configuration through CI/CD pipelines and hands-on ITGC validation. You'll bring subject matter expertise to both dimensions of AI in scope: auditing AI (assessing how OKX's AI/ML systems are built, governed, and monitored) and auditing with AI (applying AI tools to your own scoping, testing, and reporting) while also flexing into adjacent domains such as cloud security and identity, resilience engineering, secure SDLC, and data engineering. You'll help shape the risk-based audit plan by identifying emerging infrastructure risks, and partner closely with Engineering, SRE, and Security stakeholders to deliver findings and recommendations that hold up in a fast-moving, high-technology crypto environment.

What You'll be Doing

•

Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Audit (SME): Deep, hands-on expertise auditing cloud platforms (Alibaba Cloud, AWS), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm).

•

AI Use, Adoption & Governance: Two dimensions, both required.

•

Auditing AI: Assessing how AI/ML systems are built, deployed, and monitored — model and data lineage, training-data provenance and quality, access to models and prompts, human-in-the-loop and approval controls, evaluation and drift monitoring, and alignment to emerging AI governance and regulatory expectations.

•

Auditing with AI: A demonstrated bias toward using AI in your own audit work — scoping, evidence review, control testing, script generation, and reporting — and an interest in helping the function build reusable AI-enabled audit tooling.

What We Look For in You

•

Crypto & Blockchain Acumen: Prior experience at a crypto exchange or with a crypto product is preferred.

•

Critical Thinking for Complex Environments: A proven capacity to analyze novel technical and control environments unique to crypto, identify intricate root causes, and propose effective, context-specific remediation that engineering teams will actually adopt.

•

Breadth Across Adjacent Platform Domains: Demonstrable experience auditing control design and operating effectiveness in several of the following:

•

Cloud security and identity — IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, encryption and key management

•

Site reliability and resilience — observability, incident and problem management, capacity, backup and disaster recovery

•

Software development lifecycle — code review, branch protection, artifact integrity, secure SDLC, third-party and open-source dependency risk

•

Data engineering and analytics — integrity and quality of data pipelines and ETL processes

•

AI/ML platform and MLOps — model registries, feature stores, inference infrastructure, and the data feeding them

Nice to Haves

•

Cloud or Security Certifications: AWS or GCP professional-level certification, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), CISA, CISSP, or CCSK/CCSP.

•

Crypto and blockchain literacy: regulated financial-services, fintech, or crypto experience.

•

Mandarin speaking

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

We are hiring a Senior Database Reliability Engineer for our Infrastructure Platform Team. You will design PostgreSQL platforms for resilience and high availability, automate everything you touch, and understand how our services use the database, from connection pools to ORM transactions. Your goal is to keep latency within SLO at a reasonable cost, through every change, failover and migration.
Our stack today: AWS RDS and Aurora (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Redshift, ClickHouse, Terraform, Ansible, Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics and Grafana, with Java services on Kubernetes.


Responsibilities:
• Design and run highly available PostgreSQL across zones and regions, with automated, tested failover and fencing against split-brain.

• Define all database infrastructure as code (clusters, parameters, networking, access, monitoring and backups), reviewed by peers and applied through CI/CD pipelines, with drift detection.

• Build self-service database provisioning so product teams get a production-ready database without waiting on a ticket.Plan and execute migrations, upgrades and table moves with zero or near zero downtime, including cross-version, cross-cluster and cross-cloud work.

• Partner with developers on schema changes, queries, connection pooling, transaction scope, retries and expand-and-contract migrations, so database issues are fixed at their source.

• Define SLOs and build SLO-based alerts and dashboards (Prometheus, Grafana or similar) that catch latency and capacity problems before clients do.

• Design backup and recovery, and prove it with scheduled restore and failover tests that measure RTO and RPO and produce evidence for auditors.

• Keep cost in view: right-size instances and storage, and choose the cheapest option that meets the requirement.

• Secure the data: least-privilege access, secrets from a secrets manager, encryption at rest and in transit, audited access and PII masking.

• Lead and take part in incident response and on-call, write blameless post-mortems and make sure their actions get done.

• Replace manual runbooks with automation, and document what remains.

Requirements: 
• Deep PostgreSQL production experience. You have run PostgreSQL at scale and understand MVCC, vacuum and bloat, locking, replication (physical and logical) and query planning from real incidents, not only from documentation.

• Infrastructure as code as your normal way of working. Everything you build lives in version control and is reviewed before it is applied.

• CI/CD in your day-to-day work. Your infrastructure and database changes, including schema migrations, reach production through pipelines. If console clicks, SSH changes or wiki steps are how changes normally happen in your current role, this position is not the right fit.

• 5+ years running production databases as a DBRE, SRE, platform or database engineer, ideally with a large part on AWS (RDS or Aurora).

• Experience designing high availability and disaster recovery: replication, automated failover, multi-region or multi-cloud redundancy, and the trade-offs between RTO, RPO and cost.

• A track record of zero-downtime changes: online migrations, major version upgrades or moving data between clusters.

• Understanding of how applications use databases: connection pools, ORMs (for example Hibernate), transaction scope, retries and idempotency, and safe deployment order.

• Observability skills: you define what to measure, alert on SLOs and verify changes with data.Scripting in Python, Bash or Go to automate operational work.

• Comfort in a regulated financial services environment, where access control, encryption and audit trails are non-negotiable.

• Clear communication: you reason out loud, own outcomes and partner with developers instead of gatekeeping.

• Terraform and Ansible specifically, since they are our current tools.

• MySQL in production.

• Logical replication or CDC tooling (pglogical, AWS DMS, Debezium).

As a Customer Success Agent you will serve as a primary subject matter expert for Coinbase’s products, providing world-class service and support to our most valued customers. • Responsible for providing support for high-profile Coinbase customers across multiple channels (phone, messaging & email) by investigating, troubleshooting and resolving customer issues.

• Be a trusted advisor, listen and empathize so the customer knows they are valued. Ensure their voices are heard through accurate issue tracking and upstream solutions.

• Take ownership and use critical thinking to find the root cause and solve the customer issue on the first contact. Where this is not possible, ensure all defects are logged appropriately.

• Seek opportunities to add value for customers through education, proactivity and clear expectation setting.

• You will be responsible for providing best in class customer support, handling customers proactively to mitigate issues, handling contacts through to resolution, and collaborating across teams of subject matter specialists to fix issues with urgency.

• Proactively identify customer needs before they become an issue to simplify the customer experience, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in Coinbase.

• Champion clear communication with internal and external partners to align on solutions and drive results.

• Develop a deep understanding of Coinbase products and ongoing changes in the macro crypto environment so you can guide customers to navigate the quickly moving and ever changing crypto world and unlock additional features, services, and products that benefit their unique profile.

• This role requires full-time, in-office presence, five days a week.

• Willingness to work nights and weekends to support the 24/7 nature of cryptocurrency markets.

• Motivated by Coinbase’s mission and creating a seamless experience for our highest value customers.

• Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in a customer service or support role in a fast paced environment including working with high value customers.

• Basic knowledge of blockchain, web3, staking, ROI/staking rewards, self-custody, and/or crypto.

• Flexible and adaptable to meet the evolving needs of a high-growth and fast paced organization.

• Fantastic communication and relationship management skills, passion for assisting customers to use Coinbase products successfully, and an eagerness to create a community of high value Coinbase power users.

Nice to haves:

• Experience at crypto exchanges or in financial services, ideally in payments, trading operations or technical support.

• High level of proficiency in cryptocurrency and Coinbase products

• Experience in training and/or quality auditor roles

• Experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Corporate Finance, Asset Management or FinTech

• Understanding of Google apps, JIRA, Salesforce Service Cloud, or Amazon Connect.

Coinbase Creative Studio operates at the intersection of art, culture, and technology. We create original, high-impact work that helps define the Coinbase brand and bring our products to life in differentiated ways. Our portfolio spans large-scale brand and product campaigns with month-long timelines, as well as high-priority assets that need to move from brief to delivery the same day. We partner closely with internal creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and some of the world’s leading agencies and production partners to deliver work across channels and formats.

As Design Operations Manager, you will own and evolve the operating model that enables our design and motion teams to do their best work. You will sit at the center of our creative ecosystem, connecting people, processes, partners, and priorities across a diverse portfolio of work. You will own resource planning for full-time and contract design and motion talent, set resource and capacity strategy across the portfolio, and help scale the studio through a global ecosystem of agency and production partners. You will own the process for how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported, and lead selected creative initiatives across multiple workstreams. You will bring structure and clarity to a fast-moving environment while protecting the quality, timeliness, and ambition of the work. This role is ideal for an experienced design operations leader who has delivered creative work for world-class brands and products across a range of media, and who knows how to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution.

What You’ll Do

• Define and own the design and motion operating model for Creative Studio, including how work is planned, resourced, prioritized, reviewed, delivered, and reported.

• Set resource and capacity strategy across a broad portfolio of creative work, balancing business priorities, timelines, skill sets, and team health.

• Build and scale a global ecosystem of contract talent, agencies, and production partners, including sourcing, onboarding, engagement, and management of external partner performance.

• Establish operating rhythms, planning systems, and reporting that give senior stakeholders clear visibility into capacity, priorities, risks, and delivery.

• Lead high-impact design and motion initiatives across multiple workstreams, ensuring the work meets a high bar for quality, scope, timeliness, and brand expression.

• Partner with creatives, producers, strategists, marketers, and senior cross-functional stakeholders to translate complex business priorities into executable creative plans.

• Identify bottlenecks and create scalable tools, processes, and solutions that increase the team’s speed, effectiveness, and ability to deliver exceptional work.

What We Look For in You

• Bachelor’s degree in design, business, communications, or a related field; relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• Significant experience leading design operations, creative operations, production management, or a related function within a high-performing creative organization.

• A track record of delivering creative work for world-class brands and products across multiple media, channels, and complex business contexts.

• Proven experience developing resource strategy and managing global networks of contract design and motion talent, agencies, and production partners.

• Exceptional organizational judgment, with the ability to set priorities, anticipate tradeoffs, and create clarity across complex and shifting workstreams.

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, lead through ambiguity, and drive alignment across creative, marketing, production, and business teams.

• A high bar for creative quality, strong communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to move work forward across in-house teams and agency partners through clear processes and influence.

As a Senior Associate, Compliance Model Governance on the Compliance team, you'll own quantitative testing, monitoring, and data quality for the AI and statistical models that power Coinbase's financial crime compliance programs, including transaction monitoring models. You'll sit between Compliance, Data Science, and Engineering, designing the tests, building the pipelines and dashboards that track model health, and ensuring every model in production is defensible to Internal Audit and regulators.

What you'll do:

• Design and execute quantitative testing for AI and ML models before and after launch, including input data quality testing, variance and stability testing, and performance testing for agentic and LLM-based systems, producing documentation that holds up to independent model validation and regulatory examination.

• Build and maintain monitoring pipelines and dashboards that track model inputs, outputs, and downstream outcomes (e.g., SAR performance metrics), applying statistical tests to detect drift and degradation and delivering clear health readouts to model owners and Compliance leadership.

• Write production-quality SQL and Python pipelines, diagnosing and fixing pipeline bugs and leading data migrations that support external regulatory reporting.

• Build detective monitoring scenarios that test whether compliance controls are working, writing and validating the underlying SQL logic.

• Prepare testing evidence, model documentation, and walkthroughs for Internal Audit, model validators, and regulators, responding to findings and tracking remediation to closure.

Required Skills and Experience:

• 4+ years of experience in data science, model risk, quantitative analytics, or data engineering, ideally in financial services, fintech, or another regulated setting.

• Strong grounding in applied statistics (hypothesis testing, drift and stability measures, sampling, confidence intervals) with hands-on experience evaluating ML models, including testing LLM-based or agentic systems (e.g., accuracy against human-reviewed samples, variance across runs, input and payload monitoring).

• Advanced SQL and Python skills with experience building monitoring dashboards and working in cloud data environments (e.g., Snowflake or Databricks), including data lineage tracing and data quality rule design.

• Demonstrated ability to write testing and model documentation that withstands independent review, and to communicate technical results clearly to non-technical compliance stakeholders and auditors.

We are inviting you, a highly motivated and results-oriented Detection Engineer to join our team on a full-time basis.

Our team has unique expertise in research, analysis, and product development. By relying on technical insights and a data-driven approach, we create disruptive future-defining innovations of the fin-tech industry that remain our basis for success.
Our role mission is to make priority threats visible and actionable by building, testing and tuning detections for attacker behaviour and control failures, and developing reliable workflows that enrich and route investigation evidence. We work closely with security operations and incident responders to turn operational feedback into better signals, usable runbooks and clearer response paths. Contribute practical engineering improvements within approved detection and automation standards, escalating missing critical telemetry, high-impact detection failures and unsafe automation rather than making unauthorised response decisions.

Responsibilities

• Develop, test, tune and maintain SIEM/EDR detections for assigned priority attacker behaviours and control failures within the detection standards, using evidence to reduce false positives while preserving required coverage.

• Experience with Elastic Security, Microsoft Defender or similar SIEM/EDR platforms and security workflow tools.

• Practical use of Sigma, YARA or other detection-content formats, and mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

• Experience with a scripting language, a specific SIEM query language or SOAR tooling that helps maintain the assigned integrations and workflows.

• Validate telemetry availability and quality; resolve missing fields, unreliable data and broken dependencies with the relevant owners.

• Document detection logic, assumptions, limitations, owners, test evidence, runbooks and expected analyst actions.

• Support detection-gap analysis after incidents, threat-intelligence updates and service changes, and work with SOC and IR to improve telemetry, runbooks, alert context and handoffs.

• Build low-risk automations for triage, enrichment, routing, evidence collection and reporting, with approvals, access controls, logging, failure handling and rollback; validate with SOC, IR and domain owners before operational use.

• Monitor the reliability of assigned detections and workflows, diagnose failures, and maintain documentation and recovery steps.

• Provide operational support for agreed detection-platform components, following approved diagnostic and recovery procedures, sharing knowledge within the team and escalating issues beyond the assigned scope.

• Approve rule logic and tuning changes that conform to the detection standards, and low-risk enrichment/routing changes within delegated automation authority; escalate deviations to the detection manager and submit response automations and integrations through the required approval path.

• Escalate missing critical logs, high-impact detection failures, unsafe or failed workflows and high-impact action requests to the detection manager.

Requirements

• Translate a defined attacker behaviour or control-failure scenario into working SIEM or EDR detection logic, explaining the signal, required data, assumptions, limitations and expected analyst action.

• Write and troubleshoot security-data queries; correlate relevant events and verify the fields, timestamps, source coverage and data quality needed for a detection to work.

• Design repeatable tests for expected suspicious and benign activity, interpret the results, and retain evidence of what the detection does and does not cover.

• Investigate noisy alerts and tune detection logic or exceptions without removing required coverage; use analyst feedback and evidence to justify changes.

• Use incident findings, threat-intelligence context and attacker techniques to improve assigned detection content and identify gaps.

• Document rules, owners, dependencies, validation results and linked runbooks so another engineer or analyst can understand and maintain the work.

• Build and troubleshoot API-based integrations and low-risk security workflows for enrichment, routing, evidence collection or reporting; apply appropriate access, logging, failure handling, testing and rollback controls. No particular scripting language is required.

• Diagnose failures in assigned rules, telemetry dependencies and workflows, distinguish a local engineering issue from a missing upstream dependency, and escalate critical gaps with actionable evidence.

Will be a plus

• Detection-as-code, version control, peer review, automated rule testing or continuous-integration practices.

• Relevant security training or certifications, or experience in fintech, trading, payments or crypto environments.

• 10 paid sick leave days per year

• Public holidays as per the company's approved Public holiday list

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 


THE OPPORTUNITY

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports.  - Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

 - Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

 - Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

 - Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

 - Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

 - Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

 - Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

 - Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

 - A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

 - Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

 - High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

 - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

 - Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

 - Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

 - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

 - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

 - A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Model Risk Director focused on Fraud and AI to join OKX’s Model Risk Management (MRM) function. As a senior member of the second line of defense (2LOD), this leader will provide independent oversight and effective challenge of fraud models used to detect, prevent, and manage fraud risk across OKX’s products and customer journeys.

The role will lead end-to-end validation of fraud models, from conceptual soundness, data and implementation review to outcomes analysis, performance monitoring, and remediation follow-up. The portfolio may include supervised machine learning models, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, rules-based or hybrid systems, and AI-enabled fraud applications.

The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience in fraud model validation, strong quantitative judgment, and practical experience assessing AI/ML models. This person will partner closely with Fraud, Risk, Product, Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Audit teams while maintaining the independence of the MRM function.

This is a hands-on, builder role: the successful candidate will independently establish the fraud model validation capability from the ground up, personally execute validations, and play a leading role in assessing AI-enabled systems.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Establish and own the independent validation framework for fraud models and AI-enabled decision systems across OKX products, covering conceptual soundness, data quality, implementation, and outcomes analysis, in line with SR 26-2 and equivalent model risk frameworks.

•

Assess model conceptual soundness, intended use, assumptions, and limitations.

•

Personally execute end-to-end model validations as the technical expert, including independently reproducing results through hands-on data analysis and code review.

•

Assess AI/ML and generative AI applications, including LLM-based and agentic systems, for robustness, reliability, explainability, and appropriate human oversight, applying strong applied AI evaluation expertise.

•

Perform ongoing monitoring review and periodic revalidation to ensure sustained model performance through changing fraud patterns and business conditions.

•

Provide effective challenge to model owners; communicate conclusions, limitations, and risk ratings clearly to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation through closure.

•

Build and continuously mature the fraud model validation capability, standards, and workflows within MRM.

What We Look For In You

•

Master’s or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience.

•

10+ years of quantitative, fraud risk, or model risk experience, with a recognized track record as a hands-on technical expert who personally delivers independent validations of models and decision systems.

•

Excellent communication and judgment, including the ability to explain quantitative findings to senior audiences and constructively challenge model owners.

•

Practical experience with statistical and machine learning methods; proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of SR 11-7 or equivalent model risk and AI governance frameworks.

•

Experience with AI/ML governance and controls, including explainability, fairness, robustness, ongoing monitoring, or generative and agentic AI applications in fraud operations.

Nice to Haves

•

Experience establishing validation frameworks, methodologies, or capabilities in settings where they did not previously exist.

•

Strong applied AI capability: hands-on experience evaluating or building ML/LLM-based systems in production, including prompt engineering, evaluation harnesses, fine-tuning assessment, or agentic AI workflows; able to run red-team style testing on AI applications.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

•

The salary range for this position is $200,000 - $300,000

•

The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

Notice:

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Job Description
We are seeking a commercially driven, client-focused Relationship Manager to convert qualified leads into active, engaged clients and grow an assigned portfolio through a value-based relationship approach. The role focuses on client activation, deposits, trading activity, retention, reactivation and sustainable revenue growth, while ensuring a high standard of client service and adherence to approved commercial, compliance and security requirements. Qualified leads are generated through Marketing and Partnerships, with the Relationship Manager responsible for maximising the value of those opportunities and existing client relationships. You will work within a culturally diverse team and collaborate closely with Customer Service, Customer Operations, Payments, Product, Compliance and other relevant functions. Fluency in English and Russian is required.
Responsibilities:
1. Lead Conversion & Client Activation
•
Manage qualified leads allocated by Marketing and Partnerships, making timely contact in line with agreed service levels and conversion expectations.
•
Understand prospective clients’ needs, experience, and objectives through consultative conversations and guide them through the onboarding and initial funding journey.
•
Address routine objections and conversion blockers, coordinating with relevant teams where additional support is required.
•
Meet agreed individual activation, funding, and conversion targets while maintaining a client-first approach.
2. Client Relationship Management & Lifecycle
•
Build professional, trusted relationships with assigned clients through regular, personalised engagement across approved voice, social, and digital channels.
•
Understand clients’ trading needs and objectives, keep them informed of relevant product or service developments, and ensure a consistently high level of relationship support.
•
Identify inactive or at-risk clients, understand potential reasons for disengagement, and support appropriate retention or reactivation activity.
•
Listen to client feedback, needs and concerns and coordinate timely resolution of issues or complaints with the relevant internal teams.
3. Revenue Growth & Commercial Performance
•
Meet and exceed individual KPIs covering revenue, deposits, conversion, activity, and other agreed commercial measures.
•
Identify opportunities to grow client value through appropriate product education, account engagement and value-based upselling or cross-selling within approved commercial parameters.
•
Explain relevant promotions, account benefits and commercial offerings clearly, escalating requests or exceptions outside delegated authority.
•
Use available CRM data, reports, action items, and business insights to prioritise activity and improve portfolio outcomes.
4. Market Knowledge, Client Needs & Operational Discipline
•
Maintain strong working knowledge of FX/CFD products, trading terminology, account types and the company’s offering, and continuously develop understanding of financial markets.
•
Stay informed on material economic indicators, central-bank decisions and market events, translating relevant information into clear, client-appropriate explanations within approved regulatory and company frameworks.
•
Maintain accurate and complete CRM records and provide individual performance updates or reports when required.
•
Adhere to all applicable compliance, security, conduct and client-communication requirements, escalating potential risks, customer issues and commercial exceptions appropriately.

Qualifications
Qualifications
Essential:
Education & Experience
•
3–4 years of relevant experience in relationship management, sales or client-facing commercial roles, preferably within a CFD/FX brokerage or closely related financial-services environment.
•
Fluency in English and Russian, both spoken and written.
•
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, convert opportunities and deliver against individual commercial KPIs such as revenue, deposits, activation or trading activity.
Technical Skills
•
Strong working knowledge of FX/CFD markets, currency pairs, trading concepts, and the factors that influence market activity.
•
Confident use of CRM systems, sales reporting tools, and MS Office, with the ability to maintain accurate client and performance data.
•
Ability to interpret client and performance information, identify opportunities and use data to prioritise relationship activity.
Core Skills & Behaviours
•
Strong consultative selling and relationship-building skills, with a value-based approach to client growth, retention and service.
•
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain information clearly and adapt style across different clients and cultures.
•
Commercially aware and target-driven, while maintaining sound judgement and operating within regulatory, compliance and conduct requirements.
•
Strong problem-solving, prioritisation and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client needs in a fast-paced environment.
•
Proactive, self-motivated, and collaborative, with a continuous-learning mindset and willingness to take ownership of outcomes.
Desirable:
•
University degree or equivalent in Business, Finance, Economics or related field.
•
Previous experience covering the relevant language market or client segment within a CFD/FX brokerage.
•
Knowledge of trading platforms such as MetaTrader or comparable client trading platforms.
•
Additional language capability relevant to the company’s client markets.

【bitbank. cc】

ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる
Values

何事にも真摯に取り組み、関わるすべての人を尊重する。

• Write and maintain operational documentation, playbooks, and detection rule rationale so institutional knowledge isn't concentrated in one or two people.

Query/rule-writing experience in ES|QL, EQL, KQL, or equivalent. 3. Alert triage, enrichment, and case management with ticketing systems. 4. Comfort reading raw logs (auth events, CloudTrail-style audit logs, process trees) without relying solely on pre-built dashboards.

At CoinDesk, we do more than report on the future of money. We actively help shape it. As the global leader in crypto news, indices, and events, we provide the transparency and context the world needs to understand the digital asset revolution. Our team is dedicated to a shared mission: informing, educating, and connecting the global community.
Our impact is amplified by our position within the Bullish Group. Bullish is a regulated, institutional-grade exchange known for technological prowess. Operating as a subsidiary, CoinDesk is backed by a partner that shares our belief in the transformative power of digital assets.
We value engineers who treat development as a craft. You will own outcomes from concept to deployment. We expect you to navigate the unknown and bring structure to ambiguity. You will help shape the frameworks and processes that drive our global teams forward. We refuse to compromise on quality. We seek problem solvers who thrive on high-impact technical challenges.

The Team: CoinDesk Media Engineering:
The CoinDesk Media Engineering Team builds and optimizes the digital touchpoints that connect millions of global readers to the digital asset economy. Our mission is to ensure seamless, real-time access to breaking journalism, multimedia, and market intelligence for millions of readers worldwide. We are responsible for the architecture, development, and optimization of coindesk.com, the CoinDesk mobile applications, and the high-availability services layer behind both.

What You’ll Do:
• End-to-End Delivery Excellence: Own features across the complete product lifecycle. You will lead scoping alongside product and design, oversee shipping, and monitor systems in production. You will ensure systems remain secure, fault-tolerant, and performant.
• Full-Stack Execution: Architect and ship robust functionality across our web platform, mobile applications, and services layer. You will build high-quality solutions using Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, and modern runtime services.
• AI-Native Engineering: Leverage AI tools as a default part of how you design, build, and optimize software. We use Claude Code, Open Code, and open-source models daily. You will also identify opportunities to build internal tooling that streamlines workflows for editors, designers, and product partners.
• Direct Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner directly with product managers, UX designers, and editorial stakeholders in a nimble team setting. You will take initiatives from rough conceptual drafts to production reality without unnecessary organizational overhead.
• Safe Release & Operational Governance: Champion progressive rollout practices using feature flags such as LaunchDarkly. Implement automated CI/CD pipelines and disciplined observability. You will deploy frequently with confidence and minimal blast radius.

What You’ll Bring:
• Senior-Level Production Experience: 5+ years of shipping production-grade software. You have deep, hands-on authority across modern web architectures (Next.js and React) and backend environments (Node.js and TypeScript). You also have strong experience with RESTful APIs and content management platforms.
• Web Performance & Architecture Mastery: Advanced expertise in Next.js, server-side rendering (SSR), and modern caching patterns. You demonstrate deep knowledge of Core Web Vitals optimization to deliver lightning-fast experiences for a massive global readership.
• Quality as a Feature: A fundamental commitment to software quality. You implement rigorous automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end suites with Playwright and Maestro. Testing is an inherent part of your development process, not an afterthought.
• Pragmatic Craftsmanship: A strong bias toward action and simplicity. You thrive in a collaborative environment. You can take existing systems, eliminate technical friction, and make codebases enjoyable and sustainable to scale.
• End-to-End DevSecOps Mindset: Practical experience managing CI/CD pipelines and embedding security best practices. You have hands-on experience integrating secure identity systems like Auth0 across client and server boundaries.
• Collaborative Problem Solving: Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with non-engineering stakeholders. You excel at translating product vision into clean, maintainable technical execution.

Nice to Haves:
• Cross-Platform Mobile Engineering: Hands-on experience building or maintaining mobile apps using React Native and Expo.
• Publishing & Headless Architecture: Experience with modern headless CMS platforms, such as Sanity, and structured content workflows at scale.
• Monetization & Analytics Infrastructure: Prior work integrating ad management engines (Google Ad Manager), digital paywalls and billing (Stripe), and behavioral analytics (Amplitude and HubSpot).
• Cloud Infrastructure & IaC: Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform, including GCP Cloud Functions, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
• Modern Runtimes & High-Performance Microservices: Curiosity or hands-on experience with emerging web runtimes like Bun and Elysia, as well as in-memory datastores like Redis.

Bullish is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are fast evolving and striving towards being a globally-diverse community. With integrity at our core, our success is driven by a talented team of individuals and the different perspectives they are encouraged to bring to work every day.

What limits it today is measurement: the sharper our attribution, marketing mix models and experiments, the more decisions we can trust it to make. • Develop and refine marketing mix models (MMM) to understand channel contribution and guide budget allocation.

• Define and document marketing metrics and KPIs so the team works from one source of truth.

About the Role

CMC Markets is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and highly capable Director of Corporate and Commercial Law to join its EMEA Legal team in London.

The successful candidate will take a leading role in providing strategic and practical legal advice across the Group's corporate and commercial activities, with particular emphasis on mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, intellectual property, commercial contracts, data protection, and other strategic business initiatives.

The role requires a senior lawyer with broad technical expertise, excellent drafting and negotiation skills, strong commercial judgement and proven experience managing and developing other lawyers.

The successful candidate will be comfortable acting as a subject-matter expert on complex legal matters, advising senior management and working collaboratively with colleagues across the business. They will also be expected to demonstrate flexibility, taking responsibility for legal matters outside their principal areas of expertise as business requirements evolve.

This is a senior position within the EMEA Legal function, combining significant legal advisory responsibilities with leadership and management of a team of senior and junior lawyers.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Law and Strategic Transactions

• Lead the provision of legal advice on corporate transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, disposals, joint ventures, strategic investments, corporate reorganisations, and other significant corporate initiatives.

• Draft, review and negotiate complex corporate transaction documents, including share purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements, joint venture agreements, and related contractual arrangements.

• Advise on corporate governance matters, corporate structures and the legal implications of strategic business decisions.

• Support transaction structuring, due diligence, negotiation, execution and post-completion implementation.

• Work closely with senior management, Finance, Strategy and other business functions on corporate projects and strategic initiatives.

• Identify and manage legal and commercial risks arising from corporate transactions and business structures.

Commercial Law and Contracts

• Lead the drafting, review and negotiation of complex and commercially significant contracts across the business.

• Advise on commercial arrangements, including strategic partnerships, outsourcing, technology, licensing, procurement, distribution and services agreements.

• Provide practical advice on contractual risk allocation, liability, indemnities, warranties, termination rights and dispute resolution provisions.

• Develop and maintain contractual standards, precedents and negotiation positions to support consistent and efficient legal risk management.

• Support business stakeholders in structuring and negotiating commercial arrangements that achieve business objectives while appropriately protecting CMC Markets' interests.

Intellectual Property

• Oversee legal matters relating to the Group's intellectual property, with particular emphasis on trademarks, brand protection and trademark portfolio management.

• Advise on trademark registration, protection, enforcement, licensing and related intellectual property matters across relevant jurisdictions.

• Work with external intellectual property advisers to manage trademark applications, oppositions, disputes and enforcement activity.

• Support the protection and commercial exploitation of the Group's intellectual property rights, including those relating to technology, software, brands and proprietary business assets.

• Advise on intellectual property ownership, licensing and protection in commercial contracts, corporate transactions and strategic partnerships.

Financial Services Regulation

• Advise on corporate and commercial matters arising in a regulated financial services environment, taking account of applicable UK financial services legislation and regulatory requirements.

• Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Information Security and other specialist functions to address legal issues arising from new products, services and business initiatives.

• Support the assessment of legal risks associated with emerging technologies, digital assets and developing financial markets business models.

Data Protection

• Provide legal advice on data protection and privacy matters, including the contractual and commercial implications of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and related legislation. Support the Data Privacy Officer in the interpretation of data protection legislation and rules.

• Support the negotiation of data processing agreements, data sharing arrangements, and other contracts involving personal data.

Legal Team Leadership and Management

• Manage, supervise and develop a team comprising senior and junior lawyers, ensuring the effective allocation and delivery of legal work.

• Provide technical guidance, oversight and quality assurance on complex legal matters handled by team members.

• Set clear objectives, manage performance and support the professional development and career progression of lawyers within the team.

• Promote a collaborative, accountable and high-performing team culture.

• Oversee workload allocation, prioritisation and resource management to ensure that legal support is delivered effectively and within business deadlines.

• Support the Head of Legal, EMEA in developing and implementing the Legal function's strategy, priorities and operating practices.

• Identify opportunities to improve legal processes, contract management, knowledge sharing and operational efficiency.

• Manage relationships with external legal advisers, including oversight of instructions, quality, budgets and legal expenditure.

General Legal Advisory and Stakeholder Management

• Act as a senior legal adviser and trusted business partner to management and stakeholders across the Group.

• Provide clear, practical and commercially focused advice on complex legal issues, balancing legal requirements, risk exposure and business objectives.

• Lead and coordinate legal support for significant cross-functional and cross-border projects.

• Work collaboratively with other members of the Legal team and specialist functions across the Group.

• Support other areas of legal work as business requirements evolve, demonstrating flexibility and a willingness to take responsibility beyond core areas of expertise.

• Communicate complex legal issues and recommendations clearly and effectively to senior executives, business stakeholders and external counterparties.

• Escalate material legal risks appropriately and contribute to effective legal risk management across the business.

Qualifications and Experience

Essential Requirements

• A law degree or equivalent education and relevant professional experience.

• Professional qualification as a solicitor in England and Wales, or an equivalent qualification in another common law jurisdiction.

• At least 10-15+ years of relevant legal experience, preferably gained at a leading law firm, a financial institution or a well-regarded in-house legal department.

• Strong working knowledge of corporate law, particularly mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, corporate transactions and associated documentation.

• Strong working knowledge of commercial law and substantial experience drafting, negotiating and advising on complex commercial contracts.

• Good working knowledge of intellectual property law, with particular emphasis on trademark protection, management and enforcement.

• Good working knowledge of UK data protection law and its application to commercial arrangements.

• A sound understanding of UK financial services law and regulation, including the legal and commercial considerations relevant to regulated financial services businesses.

• Excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to produce clear, precise and commercially effective documentation.

• Proven experience managing, supervising and developing lawyers, including individuals with different levels of seniority and experience.

• Demonstrable ability to lead complex legal matters, exercise independent judgement and provide authoritative advice to senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify material legal risks and recommend practical solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex legal matters clearly and persuasively to non-legal audiences.

• Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, delegate effectively and deliver results within demanding deadlines.

• Ability to operate independently as a senior subject-matter expert while contributing effectively to a collaborative legal team.

• A flexible, adaptable and proactive approach, including a willingness to advise on legal matters outside core areas of expertise where business needs require.

Desirable Experience

• Experience leading significant mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures or other strategic corporate transactions, whether in private practice or in-house.

• Experience working within an international financial services group, investment firm, brokerage or other FCA-regulated business.

• Experience managing international trademark portfolios and coordinating brand protection activities across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience advising on technology contracts, software licensing, intellectual property, and complex outsourcing arrangements.

• Knowledge of digital assets, including cryptoassets, tokenised securities, digital asset custody and the legal and regulatory considerations associated with emerging digital asset business models.

• Experience supporting international business operations and coordinating legal advice across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience implementing legal operations improvements, including contract management systems, legal technology and standardised legal processes.

We are looking for an experienced QA Manual Test Engineer to join our Engineering & Architecture, Core Services team on a 12 month Maximum-Term Contract. You will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of our software applications through rigorous testing and validation processes.

The QA Engineer will collaborate closely with developers and other stakeholders to identify and resolve issues, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software products to our clients. You will also be expected to manage production releases and support regression testing activities as part of the squad responsibilities.

You’ll also sharpen your skills in a modern environment. From API and backend testing through to cloud-based systems, you’ll continue to grow your technical capability while staying hands-on in meaningful work.

Why you'll like working here
Just some of the reasons you’ll love working here include:

•
Leave benefits: Accrue 5 additional annual leave entitlements each year called My Days, as well as enjoying 5 extra annual leave days once you pass 12 months. Enjoy your birthday off to spend time with family and friends, on us! Utilise a free annual charity day to give back to your community.

$0 Trades: Staff & family trading accounts with CMC Markets Invest have access to the best brokerage rates in the market - $0 trades for all domestic and international equity orders!

•
Unlimited access to a dedicated benefits & wellbeing hub where you can save money through various retailer discounts, and make use of a variety of resources that will enhance your physical and mental wellbeing

•
Collaboration: We believe that great things happen when smart people work together, that’s why we’ve made the decision to work five days in the office.

Office perks: Help yourself to free breakfast cereals, condiments, and coffee to fuel your workday. Our culture club provides opportunities for everyone whether you’re into fitness, pizza making classes, socialising or bringing out your competitive side in trivia or lawn bowls!

The role focuses on manual testing of C#/.NET applications deployed in AWS, Testing in both back-end C# server and UI JavaScript environments.

•
Primary database engines you will be working on is SQL Server and writing complex queries to be used for data validation & troubleshooting
•
Test planning and design, including test data and environment requirements
•
Creating and maintaining test plans and test scripts, ensuring proper test coverage for all functional requirements
•
Preparing and managing test data
•
Executing test scripts, recording and analysing results for variance against expected outcomes
•
Logging and tracking identified defects & monitoring them through resolution
•
Analysing defects to identify what is causing them
•
Providing feedback to the development team
•
Preparing regular test status & test completion reports for progress tracking
•
Develop testing schedules to optimise the availability of testing resources
•
Perform usability testing for system performance, reliability, scalability, and security
•
Provides internal quality assurance

What will help you be successful?

•
Must have 5+ years of experience as a QA Manual Test Engineer on medium to large IT projects (within financial services)
•
Strong manual testing experience, ideally within financial services
•
Experience with Jira, Git, and API testing
•
Testing experience across backend services and web-based UI JavaScript
•
Testing within an AWS cloud architecture
•
Ability to work in a fast-paced Agile/frequent releases environment and adapt to significant amounts of change in work assignment
•
Knowledge of primary database engines (SQL Server) with a demonstrated ability to write complex queries to be used for data validation & troubleshooting
•
High standard of attention to detail and tenacity
•
Confidence working in Agile, fast-release environments

Desirable:
•
Automation testing with JavaScript like tools
•
ISTQB Certified Tester
•
Knowledge of financial trading instruments (Shares/FX/Options/Derivatives)
•
Comfortable working in both an unstructured (ambiguity) and a highly structured (process driven) testing environment

The things we live by

CMC Markets is powered by our people. We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where our people feel confident to be themselves, feel valued and are able to do their best work. We don’t just value differences and unique perspectives, we seek them out and we invite them in, because we know it will lead to better outcomes for everyone

Click on the link to find out more about the things we live by at CMC Markets CMC Markets - Culture Video

We’re always on the lookout for great people, so even if you don’t feel you are a 100% fit, apply with your up-to-date CV and we’ll consider you for this role and any other suitable opportunities across the business.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Please be vigilant when applying for jobs online. CMC Markets will never request personal identification details, such as Date of Birth or Tax File Number prior to an offer being made. If your initial application is successful, regardless of whether you've applied directly or through an approved recruiter, you will always liaise with a representative from CMC's Talent Acquisition team. We will only discuss a role you have formally applied for via phone or email (CMC Markets email address); and never via Facebook
